label: MORNING BRIEF

stories.title: MPs order tycoon’s arrest over URC land
stories.story: MPs ordered Godfrey Kirumira’s arrest after he skipped a probe into a 1.3-acre URC plot on Kampala Road. URC cites 24,600+ encroachments.
stories.you: Buying ex-government land? Trace every lease back to the start.

stories.title: Who owns UNHCR’s office?
stories.story: UNHCR rents its office from a private firm, but the Custodian Board says it never sold it. MPs say Jinja tenants pay rent on Board properties to unclear people.
stories.you: Letting an old town building? Confirm who holds the title first.

stories.title: Shilling fell 7.8% in October
stories.story: The dollar averaged Shs4,170.48 in October, up from Shs3,868.87 in September, says the Finance Ministry. Petrol rose to Shs6,774 a litre.
stories.you: Rent set in dollars now costs more. Agree the exchange rate in the lease.

stories.title: Piped water for 50 towns
stories.story: NWSC plans a Shs650bn water programme for 50 small towns, including Kazo. It is still looking for over Shs600bn to start.
stories.you: Selling in a small town? Ask if piped water is coming there.

stories.title: National Theatre land at risk
stories.story: Artists told MPs of repeated attempts to take over the land the National Theatre stands on in Kampala. They say its future is at risk.
stories.you: Offered public land in town? Check it at the land office first.
